caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic spur, oriented horizontally and rendered in realistic detail with a focus on gold, brass, and steel tones. The main body of the spur is gold colored with shading to indicate its curved, three-dimensional shape, and it features a textured band around the middle that appears to have a crosshatch pattern in darker gold and brown hues. One end of the spur has a decorative design in gold with a symmetrical looping pattern and small circular accents. The opposite end features a silver-colored, multi-pointed rowel (the rotating spiked wheel) attached to a circular gold structure, which is detailed with some ornamental cutouts and small gold rivets. The background is a plain, off-white, lightly textured surface with some minor discolorations or spotting near the edges. The composition is centered on the page with the spur positioned so the rowel is to the left and the decorated end is to the right.
title: Spur
